title: Rabby Swap legacy router (19 chains) — arbitrary-call approval-drain still live, but ~$0 residual value
closed_reasons: No material live allowance remains anywhere: 3,940 historical (token,owner) approval pairs across 19 chains, of which only 3 are still live and all are dust
Ethereum (the main 2022 chain) has 0 live positions across 498 pairs; Arbitrum 0/627; Avalanche 0/123; Gnosis 0/72; Optimism 0/573; Fantom 0/59
BNB Chain's only live position is 10 WEAR, a token with no DEX pair and no price ($0)
Polygon's two live positions are AURUM (~$0.00002) and LUNA (~$0.13) dust
0 ERC-721/1155 ApprovalForAll(operator=router) events on any chain
The router holds 0 tokens/native on every chain (no 'stuck' bucket)
key_facts: Source of the address list: RevokeCash/approval-exploit-list/exploits/rabby.json (19 chainId+address entries)

Bug: swap() (selector 0x32854cc2) performs an unvalidated external call dexRouter.functionCallWithValue(data,value) with caller-controlled target+calldata; the router executes token.transferFrom(victim,attacker,amount) as itself, spending the victim's standing allowance

Ethereum router 0x6eb211CAF6d304A76efE37D9AbDFAdDC2d4363d1 is unverified, immutable, and its runtime code at the 2022 exploit block 15,724,451 (keccak 0xc721ffeb…3895) is byte-identical to the code at the latest block — never patched
All 18 reachable deployments are 10,402 bytes and paused()==false; the three runtime hashes differ only in the trailing 43-byte Solidity metadata (functional code identical)

Fork PoC: a fresh caller 0x1111… drains a third party's 1,000,000 USDC standing approval through the live Ethereum router in one tx (gas 123,328); historical replay at block 15,724,451 drains 5,204.918440 USDC from 6 known victims
Census: 14,156 Approval logs, 3,940 unique (token,owner) pairs, 3 live positions, total extractable $0.13
Owner of the family is 0x2Cc26F59379832fDe97a6c35Abcd80D672846194 (Boba differs); feeRatio 875 (8.75%); none paused
caveats: Long-tail chains (cronos, harmony, moonbeam, astar, arbitrum-nova, celo, klaytn) could only be scanned over a bounded window because their public RPCs cap eth_getLogs ranges; the window always starts at the deployment block, covering the Sept-Oct 2022 approval window first
HECO (chainId 128) has no reachable RPC — its deployment is unverifiable (chain is effectively dead)
One Optimism (token,owner) pair could not be read (RPC error) — reported as unread, not as live
Dust positions are valued at DefiLlama spot and are not worth liquidation; no position reaches $1k
Point-in-time 2026-10-23; read-only, no mainnet transactions; no secrets stored
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can still drain any wallet that holds a standing allowance to the legacy Rabby Swap router (fork-proven, gas ~123k, 18 chains unpaused), but a full 19-chain census finds only $0.13 of live dust remaining — headline E-U ~$0.00; keep as a latent re-arming risk only.
